setup.text: A traveler visits regularly to trade but refuses every invitation to settle.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The trader continues visiting and brings rare materials.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The village learns that friendship does not require permanent belonging.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The trader accepts a night's shelter and shares stories.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The trader declines kindly and leaves at dawn.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The trader feels insulted and avoids the village.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A child wonders why movement makes someone seem suspicious.
